Rae (Docs): quick sync — I want to land a micro-guide that shows short-seq defaults for Optimize (microBatch + kvPrefetch + q4 profile), plus a tiny migration note. Drafting PR now.

Omar (SDK): 👍 keep examples minimal. Use canonical param names: microBatch, kvPrefetch, quantProfile. For JS show promise API; for Py show stream.

Lin (ML): add a one-line quality caution: q4 can change generation behavior for some models — recommend smoke evals.

Rae (Docs): draft JS (promise):
```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/optimize-client');
const client = new OptimizeClient();
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rwkv-7b', prompt: 'Summarize:', maxTokens: 48, microBatch: 6, kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_0' });
console.log(out.text);
```

Rae (Docs): draft Py (stream):
```python
from redwood.optimize import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
for chunk in client.stream(model='rwkv-7b', prompt='Continue', micro_batch=2, kv_prefetch=True, quant_profile='q4_0'):
    print(chunk.text)
```

Mina (PM): please add a short migration anchor "old names: batch_size, prefetch_kv" and a tiny sed example for power users.

Rae (Docs): adding migration note: `s/batch_size/micro_batch/g`, `s/prefetch_kv/kv_prefetch/g`. Also a safer perl one-liner suggestion that keeps backups.
